jobs.title: On-Camera Presenter & Content Host
jobs.summary: Present confidently on camera for brand, educational, promotional and social content. Strong freshers with clear communication and natural camera presence are welcome to apply.
jobs.descriptionMd:
We are looking for On-Camera Presenters & Content Hosts to appear in branded, promotional, educational and social media content across Fixen Media and selected brands.

This role is for people who can communicate naturally and confidently in front of a camera while adapting their delivery to different subjects, audiences and formats.

You may present scripted content, explain products or services, host short-form videos, introduce campaigns, participate in interviews or deliver informational content.

Previous professional presenting experience is not mandatory. Strong freshers with good communication skills, confidence and a natural on-camera presence are encouraged to apply.

We value clarity, authenticity and adaptability more than exaggerated presenting styles.
jobs.responsibilitiesMd:
- Present scripted and semi-scripted content on camera.
- Deliver information clearly, naturally and confidently.
- Adapt tone, pacing and delivery based on the brand and content format.
- Learn scripts or key talking points before recording.
- Work with directors, scriptwriters and production teams during shoots.
- Take direction and adjust delivery across multiple takes.
- Present promotional, educational, interview-style and social content.
- Maintain professional preparation and punctuality for scheduled productions.
- Support content development with delivery feedback where useful.
- Participate in rehearsals, screen tests or production preparation when required.
- Maintain appropriate presentation and appearance based on the production brief.
jobs.requirementsMd:
- Clear verbal communication skills.
- Confidence speaking in front of a camera.
- Ability to understand and deliver scripts naturally.
- Good pronunciation and audience awareness.
- Ability to adjust tone and delivery based on direction.
- Ability to remain composed through multiple takes.
- Professional attitude and reliability during productions.
- Comfortable working with a production team.
- Ability to communicate in Bengali and/or English depending on the content.
- A short presentation sample, self-recorded video, previous work or willingness to complete a screen test.

Previous professional presenting experience is not mandatory.
jobs.niceToHaveMd:
- Previous presenter, host or acting experience.
- Short-form social media presenting experience.
- Interview or event-hosting experience.
- Voice-over experience.
- Strong bilingual Bengali-English communication.
- Teleprompter experience.
- Experience presenting technical, educational or commercial topics.
- Basic understanding of social media content.
- Script interpretation skills.
- Public-speaking experience.
benefits: Work on real brand and social media productions
Exposure to multiple content formats and industries
Opportunity to develop professional on-camera experience
Collaboration with writers, directors and production teams
Opportunity to build a diverse presenter portfolio
